slides.title: Five options to reach the SME growth target

items: Grow the SME desk from the existing branch network over three years.
Buy a lending platform and migrate the book within 18 months.
White-label onboarding and share revenue on originated loans.
Form a 50/50 vehicle with a regional insurer for bancassurance.
Hold the current footprint and defend margin through pricing.

slides.takeaway: Only two of the five options reach the target inside the plan period.

quotes.name: Ana Ruiz

quotes.text: The dashboard is the first thing I open every morning.
quotes.name: Tom Becker

quotes.text: Support answers within the hour, every time.
quotes.name: Li Wei

quotes.text: We retired three legacy tools in the first quarter.
quotes.name: Sara Holm

quotes.text: Pricing is transparent; no surprises at renewal.
quotes.name: James Okoro

quotes.text: Reporting that used to take a week now takes a morning.
quotes.name: Marta Silva

quotes.text: The API let us integrate without a consultant.
quotes.name: Ben Arnaud

quotes.text: Our auditors now ask for the export by name.
quotes.name: Ida Lund
